about: sha256 of each sample city's city_model.json (citygen build output, M3: buildings, skybridges, megasites). The same bytes on every machine with the pinned requirements: produced on the cloud machine (x86_64 Linux), confirmed with GEOS 3.14.1 rebuilt with clang against libc++ (the C++ library of macOS builds) and with one worker and another PYTHONHASHSEED; traces of every stage are in docs/progress/M1b_det/ (M1b), docs/progress/M2/<city>/trace.json (M2) and docs/progress/M3/<city>/trace.json (M3). tests/test_roads.py asserts them on every run.
